Track how many times in a row the same type of error has occurred:

content.text: I will now calculate the average percentage change in sales for each attribute type. I will start by creating a CTE that calculates the sales for each attribute value for the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020. Then, I will calculate the percentage change for each attribute value and finally, I will calculate the average percentage change for each attribute type. I will repeat this for all the requested attribute types and combine the results using UNION ALL. I will then identify the attribute with the highest negative impact.

args.sql:
WITH SalesByRegion AS (
    -- Calculate sales for 'region'
    SELECT
        'region' AS attribute_type,
        region AS attribute_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-03-23' AND DATE '2020-06-14' THEN sales END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-06-15' AND DATE '2020-09-06' THEN sales END) AS after_sales
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    GROUP BY region
),
SalesByPlatform AS (
    -- Calculate sales for 'platform'
    SELECT
        'platform' AS attribute_type,
        platform AS attribute_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-03-23' AND DATE '2020-06-14' THEN sales END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-06-15' AND DATE '2020-09-06' THEN sales END) AS after_sales
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    GROUP BY platform
),
SalesByAgeBand AS (
    -- Calculate sales for 'age_band'
    SELECT
        'age_band' AS attribute_type,
        age_band AS attribute_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-03-23' AND DATE '2020-06-14' THEN sales END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-06-15' AND DATE '2020-09-06' THEN sales END) AS after_sales
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    GROUP BY age_band
),
SalesByDemographic AS (
    -- Calculate sales for 'demographic'
    SELECT
        'demographic' AS attribute_type,
        demographic AS attribute_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-03-23' AND DATE '2020-06-14' THEN sales END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-06-15' AND DATE '2020-09-06' THEN sales END) AS after_sales
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    GROUP BY demographic
),
SalesByCustomerType AS (
    -- Calculate sales for 'customer_type'
    SELECT
        'customer_type' AS attribute_type,
        customer_type AS attribute_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-03-23' AND DATE '2020-06-14' THEN sales END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2020-06-15' AND DATE '2020-09-06' THEN sales END) AS after_sales
    FROM bank_sales_trading.main.cleaned_weekly_sales
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
AllSales AS (
    SELECT * FROM SalesByRegion
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SalesByPlatform
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SalesByAgeBand
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SalesByDemographic
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SalesByCustomerType
)
SELECT
    attribute_type,
    AVG(100.0 * (after_sales - before_sales) / before_sales) AS average_percentage_change
FROM AllSales
WHERE before_sales > 0 AND after_sales > 0 -- Ensure we don't divide by zero or have missing data
GROUP BY attribute_type
ORDER BY average_percentage_change;
